testable_ac.text: Qualifying visit = >=30s foregrounded + >=1 feed render; same-day dups do not increment.
Consecutive-day increment by exactly 1; persists across restarts.
Silent grace day: one missed day forgiven; grace only visible in explainer sheet.
Reset to 1 after >=2 consecutive missed days.
Anti-manipulation: tz change never decreases; max 1 increment per 20 wall-clock hrs (UTC monotonic guard).
Placement + accessibilityLabel "{n}-day Bluesky streak"; testID=streakIndicator; Home tab only.
Hidden when logged out, opted out, or streak < 2.
Tap opens Dialog with current + longest + rules + grace + Settings link. No share CTA.
Persisted storage only; no network request carries streak data.
Per-DID; account switch swaps; account removal clears.
Monday >=06:00 local if >=1 qualifying visit in prior ISO week.
Three metrics: posts authored, net new followers, top post (likes+reposts+replies).
Tap card -> full-screen Recap route embedding top post via existing post components.
Zero-posts empty copy; negative follower delta clamped to 0.
Dismissible; 4-week rolling "Past recaps" in Settings.
Auto-expires after 7 days.
No push / email / OS widget.
Fetched via getAuthorFeed + getProfile for own DID; manual Retry; auto-retry capped at 2/hr.
Renders under RTL, long strings, screen reader, reduced-motion, large text.
Moderation fallback: deleted/hidden top post -> next-highest; none -> empty copy.
"Show weekly recap" OFF prevents computation entirely.
Client-only compute; analytics carry booleans only.
Settings -> Activity & recap sub-screen, both toggles ON by default, <1s to take effect, no restart.
Toggles persist per-account locally; no atproto prefs sync in v0.
No NUX / modal / interstitial on first install.
No numerical badges on app icon / tab bar / drawer.
Lingui-wrapped strings, no hardcoded English.
Feature-flaggable via existing gating to disable remotely without release.

ambiguous_ac.text: Three metrics: posts authored, net new followers, top post.
ambiguous_ac.question: Is "posts authored" a single combined count, or split into posts / replies / reposts? Ticket open question Q4 is unresolved. Draft spec assumes a single combined count (posts + replies + reposts authored by the user), with a path to split later without schema break.

atproto has no per-edge follow timestamps. Draft spec uses a daily follower-count snapshot ring buffer sampled on qualifying visit; delta is end-of-week minus start-of-week snapshot. Must be labeled "net change" and clamped >=0 per B4. Acceptable as v0?

If the device is offline or backgrounded across Monday 06:00, does the card appear on next foreground check the same Monday only, or any day within the 7-day expiry window? Draft: first foreground on or after Monday 06:00 local within the 7-day window triggers availability.
Is the 30s cumulative across foreground sessions on the same day, or a single contiguous 30s? Draft: single contiguous 30s while Home feed is the active surface.

guardrails: G1: No loss-aversion UI. No countdowns, no 'about to break' warnings, no push reminders.
G2: Silent grace. No celebration on grace-day use, no 'you saved it!' copy.
G3: Low visual weight. Flame + integer only; no animation, haptic, or sound on increment.
G5: No social pressure. No leaderboards, no friend streaks, no share affordance (enforced by AC-A8).
G6: No passive-engagement metrics (no time-spent, no scroll counts).
G7: No re-engagement for churned users. A 0-visit week produces no recap card (reinforces AC-B1).
G8: Default-on with prominent opt-out (one screen deep + link in explainer sheet).
G9: Client-local only. No new lexicon, no PDS record, fully reversible (reinforces AC-A9, AC-B12, AC-X2).
G10: Opt-out is permanent. Never re-prompt to re-enable.

Out-of-scope v0: streak freezes/purchases/restoration, sharing, leaderboards, friend streaks, badges/trophies/XP, push+email, server-side records, new lexicon, PDS persistence, streak on non-Home tabs, cross-device sync, editorial content in recap.
